  "implementation": "Install @skrewww/form-field, @skrewww/text-input, and @skrewww/validation-message. On app/page.tsx render FormField with label=\"Email\", controlId=\"email\", required, optional supportingText, and error when invalid; children render-prop receives { controlId, describedBy, invalid } and returns TextInput with id={controlId}, type=\"email\", required, aria-describedby={describedBy}, aria-invalid={invalid}, and error aligned with FormField. When invalid, set FormField error and use ValidationMessage type=\"error\" with matching id/announce. Preserve existing data-skrewww-shape=\"rounded\" and data-skrewww-surface=\"glass\"."
